harnessFailures.detail: GitHub anonymous API returned 403 with rate-limit remaining zero. Official fixed release download and commit-pinned codeload source succeeded without credentials.

First observer incorrectly required a Selected tasks log line. Actual installer succeeded; corrected observer checked success log, installed root license bytes and absence of the Notepad IFEO replacement section. No install retry.

First close shortcut focused the noVNC full-screen control; terminal-state checkpoint refused while launch remained running. Refocused guest, normally closed application, waited for normal exit and captured all-terminal checkpoint.

Generated helper omitted a separating newline and failed SyntaxError before execution. Subsequent update preflight refused because catalogue had not advanced; no update task created. Corrected helper activated role 37 normally.

Immediate checkpoint refused while normal launch exit or market install was still completing. Read-only inspection and bounded terminal-state polling confirmed normal successful completion; no install cancellation or retry.

Direct Python 3.9 file invocation reported source decoding failure although full UTF-8 decode and compile validation passed. An ASCII runner explicitly decoded the same bytes as UTF-8 and compiled successfully; no output evidence or signed bytes changed.
